quotes.quote: Namaakkal Maakkal Pattirangal refers to a traditional category of stone utensils, domestic wares, ritual objects, toys, and carved articles produced from the distinctive soapstone deposits native to the Namaakkal district of Tamil Nadu.
Locally known as "Maakkal," these stone vessels and artefacts are carved from a soft yet durable variety of soapstone

Differently sized kalchattis form mortars and pestles for grinding lentils, grains and spices, storage containers to food moulds, cooking utensils, serving dishes, and pans for the local bread (dosa) are crafted.

Namaakkal stone works are crafted from high-quality soapstone, a naturally soft, dense, and easily workable metamorphic rock formed through the alteration of pre- existing rocks under intense heat, pressure, and the activity of chemically reactive fluids in tectonic plate zones.
